correctness.rationale: Integrating over the distance between two designated sample points (density 2) and the forbidden union arcs yields the exact displayed C_n formula on 0<r<1/4. The derivative ratio H and quadratic sign polynomial force at most three interior roots for n≥4. At n≥21 strict alternating signs at 0+,1/n,1/6,1/4 give three, hence they are simple; n=4..20 exact rational Sturm counts of P_n(r)/r independently recomputed as one, and n=2,3 as none after strictly excluding r=1/4. Uniform c/n expansion yields nC_n(c/n)→2e^−4c(e^c−1−2c²); analytic root count bounds identify the two finite scaled limits. Finite Sturm checks do not establish the n≥21 all-size result without the analytic derivative proof.
